info.title: City Council Meeting Minutes & Agendas Scraper (Legistar)
info.description:
City council meeting scraper for Legistar: pull meetings for public Legistar cities by date range, with body, date, agenda and minutes status and links (PDF when posted), optional agenda item titles and the official source link. No login.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper
Author: Public Records.
